labels.notes: Camera-captured English IEEE IEEEtran LaTeX class document, page 21. Two-column dense text about glue types, rubber lengths, equation numbering modes. Very dense academic formatting. Grayish/faded from camera capture. Readable but low contrast.

Camera-captured Chinese linear algebra textbook, page 6. Problems 11-14: matrix invertibility, Sherman-Morrison formula, block determinants. Dense mathematical content. Diagonal light/shadow pattern from upper right. Paper slightly curled. Good content despite illumination issues.

Camera-captured English probability textbook, page 24. Solutions to Problems 2.15-2.17. PMF calculations, variance, temperature conversion. Same EXTREMELY FADED/WASHED OUT probability textbook series. Sharp text but nearly invisible - light gray on white. Very poor contrast.

Camera-captured Chinese physics textbook. §2 Light, 2.3 透镜成像 (Lens imaging). ROTATED 90 degrees clockwise. Very sparse content - only 3 short questions about convex lens experiments. Mostly blank page. Fingers visible at bottom right. Rotation + sparse content.

Camera-captured Chinese ITU-R BT.500-14 standard, page 35. DSCQS method with Figure 2-3 system layout diagram (signal source, testing system, display, preview monitor). Section A2-4 Grading Tables. Clean typed text with technical block diagram. Slightly faded.

Camera-captured Chinese chemistry periodic table (first 36 elements with symbols). ROTATED 90 degrees clockwise. Table in rounded rectangle border. H through Ba. SEVERE DIAGONAL SHADOWS from window/light source creating extreme illumination unevenness. Rotation + shadows severely degrade quality.

Camera-captured Chinese chemistry notes. Elements/molecules/atoms comparison table (含义/区别) and relationship diagram with arrows. ROTATED 90 degrees clockwise. Fingers visible at right edge. Clean typed text. Rotation reduces overall quality but content clear.

Camera-captured Chinese research proposal about object detection (目标检测). R-CNN, Faster R-CNN, RPN, deep learning detection history. Dense typed text with bold heading. Good contrast, well-structured. Highest MOS in this batch - genuinely good quality original.

Camera-captured Chinese physics textbook. §2 Light, 2.3 透镜成像, problems 8-10. Multiple choice about convex lens focal length, image formation. ROTATED 90 degrees clockwise. Fingers visible at bottom right. Clean typed text, moderate content density. Rotation is main issue.

Camera-captured Chinese linear algebra textbook, page 29. Jordan form, LR decomposition, Sylvester determinant, block diagonal matrices, Schur triangulation. Dense mathematical content with matrices. Slightly faded/grayish but very readable. Well-structured problems.
